Usage: agentcage cage destroy [OPTIONS] NAME

  Stop containers, remove quadlets, state, and scoped secrets.

Options:
  -y, --yes       Skip confirmation prompt
  --keep-secrets  Keep scoped secrets (useful for recreating the cage)
  --no-color      Disable colored output.
  --quiet         Suppress progress output (spinners and banners).
  -h, --help      Show this message and exit.
